newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING-Capital Senior Living Corp.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING-Capital Senior Living Corp.

text.p: Company Name Capital Senior Living Corp
Total shares to be offered 9.0 million

Underwriters over-allotment 1,350,000 shrs At the request of the company 450,000 shares have been reserved for sale to certain individuals, including directors and employees, members of their families and others having business relationships with the company. Business: Based in Dallas, Texas, the company is a provider of senior living services in the United States. Use of Proceeds: To complete the formation transactions, to fund development activities, to fund the potential acquisition of additional interests in the company's existing senior living communities and for general corporate purposes, including working capital.
